As we plan to continue investing broadly in digital technology and infrastructure, these costs will be part of our ongoing capital expenditures and future spending. Accordingly, it is no longer relevant to separately disclose costs associated with Herbalife One. As of December 31, 2025, we have incurred approximately $357 million of implementation costs related to Herbalife One. Beginning in the first quarter of 2024, we started recognizing non-cash amortization expenses related to Herbalife One. For the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, we recognized approximately $43 million and $35 million, respectively in non-cash amortization expenses, as the assets are amortized.
